verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents Deployments as a containers-as-a-service offering for running container images and serving ML models. That is a managed alternative to hand-run instances, but nothing in the evidence says Deployments autoscale or scale to zero. Machine auto-shutdown only stops a VM after at least an hour of inactivity, which is an adjacent control rather than serverless scale-to-zero, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented autoscaling of deployment replicas, scale-to-zero behavior, explicit GPU-backed serverless workers, per-request or idle billing details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
